{{Quote|Emergency! This is the ''Singing Savrip''! I've been attacked by an Imperial customs ship, and my stabilizers are out!|Hagk Baht|<ref name="A Night at Tosche Station">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20010621a2|text=A Night at Tosche Station|int=A Night at Tosche Station}}</ref>}}
The '''''Singing Savrip''''' was a [[Starship/Legends|ship]] owned by the [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]], [[Hagk Baht]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], Baht flew it to [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], where he was hoping to supply the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] with [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]]. However, upon arriving in the [[Tatoo system/Legends|Tatoo system]], the ship was attacked by an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] customs ship and Baht could only evade it by flying into a dust storm. The storm was very violent and the ''Savrip'' had suffered damage to its [[Stabilizer/Legends|stabilizers]], which caused it to crash into the surface of Tatooine, near [[Anchorhead/Legends|Anchorhead]]. Baht was [[Death/Legends|killed]], but not before sending an emergency transmission to his Alliance contacts.
